application_feedback.feedback: The upper desktop panel switches between complete Tide Pit and Pamplist accepted projections; the lower strip always shows accepted source, layer, capture, trim, mix, audio, MIDI, and diagnostic state.
Control mode sends absolute encoder positions, RGB action state, source/context labels, and temporary accepted parameter overlays for the selected source.
Mixer mode sends layer, capture, mute, monitor, master, and trim state; trim positions are neutral/read-only when availability is false.
Connection performs DAW enable, relative-row setup, and bounded full accepted-state resync; shutdown or explicit endpoint change constructs DAW disable before close.

endpoint_device_evidence.notes: The exact regular Novation Launch Control 3 DAW-port topology and official protocol are authority for message construction only. No endpoint is enumerated or opened, no physical message is sent or received, and no device-success claim is made.
